Commentary.Commentary: That is it from our side for this game. The first run chase lasted 35 overs and this one lasted one more as Pakistan go 2-0 up in the series. How many in the next one, 37 overs perhaps? We will catch up with you again at 0915 local (0715 GMT) on Wednesday for the third ODI. Till then, ciao!

Pakistan captain Sarfraz Ahmed starts by thanking the Almighty. Then goes on to say that Usman Khan was good for them today and later, Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman finished the job. Further praises his strike bowler Usman Khan who he believes has been good since the Sri Lankan series and he is happy with his contribution. Implies that they have to work hard and improve in the fielding department but they are learning and getting better with each game.

Man of the Match Fakhar Zaman says that the wicket was good and he was doing his best to use it to his advantage. He adds that when you're in a purple patch, you have to make the most of it. Asserts that the pitch played better in the second innings and made it easier to bat on.

Alistair Campbell is conducting the post-match presentation. He talks with Zimbabwe captain Hamilton Masakadza who starts by saying that he got out at the wrong time. Further asserts that they didn't rotate the strike enough and played too many dots in the middle overs. Implies that they need someone to make it difficult for the opposition batters in the latter half of the innings. Ends by saying that he is hopeful of getting back into the contest in the next match.

Chasing a target of 195 was never going to trouble the Pakistan batters. Their openers made the pitch look like a batting paradise as they conjured up another century stand. After Imam-ul-Haq was unfortunately run out, Babar Azam joined hands with Fakhar Zaman for an unbeaten 76-run partnership. The latter went on to score his 2nd century in the process and propelled his team to a 2-nil lead in the series. None of the Zimbabwe bowlers could get into the wickets column, which should tell you about their sorry state in this match.

Wow. What a match this has been. I've never seen a more comfortable victory in years for Pakistan. After winning the toss, Zimbabwe chose to bat on a chilly morning but they didn't start well. Usman Khan removed both the openers but their skipper Hamilton Masakadza and Tarisai Musakanda stitched an important 62-run partnership. This was crucial as it got them to a better stage, however, both lost their wickets at the wrong time and that opened the floodgates. Peter Moor was the lone warrior in the middle order but no other batters contributed. His half century did push the score for the hosts but they failed to cross 200.
Wide! An extra to end the game! Short and down the leg side, Babar allows it through and the umpire stretches his arms. All over, PAKISTAN WIN BY 9 WICKETS WITH 84 BALLS REMAINING!
Quicker around leg, Zaman tries to cut but gets a bottom edge. It rolls to the bowler. Just 1 more needed now.

FOUR! Bang! Wellington goes short on this occasion, around off, Zaman uses the depth of his crease and smashes it through cover-point. The field is up and hence there is no one in the deep to cut it off. This is now Fakhar's highest score in ODIs.
FOUR! Tossed up ball landing full around middle and leg, Zaman gets down on one knee and neatly sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.

Flatter and around leg, Fakhar gets deep inside the crease to play the cut shot but is cramped for room. He ends up getting a bottom edge through the keeper's leg for a run. Strangely, the umpire gives it as a bye. Hmm...
Tossed up ball outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Play and a miss! Tiripano bowls it full and wide outside off, Fakhar stays leg side of his delivery, throws his bat at it but fails to make any contact.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Straighter in line and it has been worked behind the square leg region for a couple of runs.
Smart batting. Sees the batsman giving the charge and making room outside off and bowls it wider of him. Zaman lets it through.
On a length around off, tapped down to point.

Dropped by Chatara! A short delivery around leg, Zaman pulls it across the line but fails to middle it quite well. It goes aerially towards short fine leg where Chatara attempts to catch it with a dive to his left but fails to hold on.
Loopy and full on the pads, turned to square leg for one.
Shortish and on middle and off, Fakhar rocks back to play the square cut but it takes the outside edge and rolls to short third man.
Plants his front foot forward and eases it through mid on for another run in this over.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it through mid off for a single.
Flighted and on leg, it's flicked through square leg for a single.
Again shortish in length from the youngster. Zaman rocks back and punches it off the back foot. One run taken.
Hangs back and works the ball to the on side.
And he misses the slog sweep this time. A rare miss for Zaman.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
A shortish ball in line of the stumps, Azam pulls it through mid-wicket for another easy run.
Slower thorugh the air, Zaman gets back and works it to the leg side. One run added to the total.
Inside edged behind the keeper. Another run taken by the batsman.

This has to be one of the easiest centuries he will ever make in his career. Another loosener outside leg, he flicks it through fine leg and scampers back for a second. The dressing room is out and about applauding his effort as he gets to his only second ODI ton in his short career. To add to that, he has been in scintillating form since the time he has stepped on the Zimbabwean soil.
Babar has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Similar delivery from Wellington, Zaman works it to the one side once again for a single. He moves to 99.
A touch short in line of the stumps, blocked off the back foot by Fakhar.
On the pads, flicked to the on side for nothing.
Comes down the track and keeps it out to the off side.
Full on off, driven to mid on by Azam.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. One run added to the total. 98 now!

FOUR! And he moves to 97 with this boundary. A tossed up ball on leg, Zaman sweeps it through square leg. The fielder in the deep dives over the ball and lets it pass to the boundary. Pakistan or Zaman won't be complaining.
Flatter and full, driven down the ground by the right-hander. One run added to the total.
A shortish delivery on middle and off, tucked to mid-wicket by Babar.
Wristy from Zaman but couldn't find the gap.
On the pads, worked to square leg for a run.

FOUR! Beautifully driven from Azam. A tossed up ball around off, he comes down the track to smother the spin and drives it through covers. Roche from long off runs to his left and puts in the dive but couldn't cut it out.
Quickly rocks back on to the back foot and keeps it out to the off side.
Comes down the track to play this one. No run taken.
Flighted on off, Azam comes forward and defends.
Zaman sweeps but straight to short third man.
Not that short but Azam still manages to get it through point for a single.
Hangs back and gets it through the off side. A brace results.
In line of the stumps, driven to mid off by Zaman. One run taken.
Defended off the front foot by Fakhar presenting the full face of the bat.
Slower outside off, nicely worked through backward point by Azam. Muzarabani shows some football skills at the boundary and keeps it under three.
Liam Roche is back on.
Azam works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Comes down the track and defends it.
Flighted on middle, pushed to mid on.
On off, tucked away through backward point by Azam. Chari from extra cover runs to his left and saves a couple for his team.
A touch short, worked to the off side for a single.
Flighted on middle, defended back to the bowler by Zaman.
Wide of off, cut to point where the fielder dives to his left and manages to save a few runs for his team. One run taken.
Full outside off, driven to covers by Zaman. He couldn't pierce the field this time.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, pushed to covers for nothing.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket by the right-hander. One run to the total.
A back of a length ball around off, punched to mid off for a quick single. He moves into 90s.
Wide! Too high over Zaman's head. The umpire signals a wide.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Uppish but safe. A floated ball on off, Zaman stays on the leg side and lofts it from the crease through covers. Two runs taken.
Slower around off, cut to backward point.
Flatter on middle, clipped to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On the pads, flicked to the on side for nothing.

FOUR! Swept and swept cleanly. Zaman into the act once again. A tossed up ball on middle, he crouches down and brings the angled bat down with power. The connection is sweet and the ball races to deep square leg boundary.
Nicely bowled this. A fullish ball around off, Zaman looks to defend but misses the ball. No harm done in the end.
A back of a length ball outside off, bottom edged on to the pitch by Zaman.
On the hips this time, Zaman guides it to fine leg. One run taken.
On a length in line of the stumps, Zaman punches it back to the bowler.
Full on off, driven to mid off for nothing.
Outside off, cut missed by Fakhar.
Donald Tiripano in into the attack.
That hit Azam on his pads. 6 off this one.
Flatter on off, punched through long off by Azam and he changes strike.
A tad shorter from Wellington, Azam gets back and gets it to the off side. One more conceded.
Tossed up around off, driven through backward point by Babar. A brace results.
Swept to fine leg for another single.
Slower ball around off, guided to the leg side by Azam. One run taken.
Wellington Masakadza is back on.

FOUR! SHOT! He doesn't miss out this time. Muzarabani dishes a fuller ball outside off, Zaman throws his bat at it and finds the gap as the ball races to the cover fence. He moves to 79 with the single.
Full on off, Zaman stays leg side and punches it to covers for nothing.
Short in line of the stumps, Fakhar misses the pull this time.
Short and wide, cut through cover-point by Babar. One run taken.
Zaman makes room to play the length ball and punches it to mid off. One run taken.
Full on middle and leg, punched off the back foot by Zaman.
Full in line of the stumps, flicked straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Outside off again, pushed to point for nothing.
A touch around off, Zaman gets it to mid off for a single.
On the pads this time, Azam clips it through mid-wicket and changes strike.
Outside off on a similar length, Babar happy to defend.
On a length targeting the stumps, Azam solidly behind the line.
Good length ball around off, Zaman defends it off his back foot to end the over. A successful one for the home team.
Short and on middle, it's pulled down to fine leg by Babar and he gets off the mark with a single.
Babar Azam is in next. A slip in place.

OUT! Run out! A wicket against the run of play. A length ball on middle, cramping Fakhar for room who tries to keep it out. Gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls near the popping crease. Imam calls him through for a quick single and Zaman responds. Muzarabani also rushes across to the ball, gets down low to pick it and then disturbs the stumps as Imam dives in. They appeal and the square leg umpire refers it upstairs. The replays roll in and they show that Imam's bat is in the air as he dives in. It's over the crease but only aerially and has not landed inside even once. Had that happened, he would have been safe according to the new ICC rules. Anyway, Zimbabwe finally get a breakthrough. Too late though, one would say. End of a 119-run stand which has nearly put this game to bed in the favour of the touring team.
Appeal for a run out. Is Imam short of the crease?
Muzarabani delivers it short again, around Imam's hips and he just tucks it down to fine leg for one.
Good length ball on middle, Imam works it from the crease to the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Starts this spell with a shortish ball around leg, it's been pulled in front of square leg for a single.
Blessing Muzarabani is back on.
On a length on off, punched off the front foot by Imam.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Outside off, cut to the off side for nothing.
Similar line and length from Tendai, defended down the track by the batsman.
A short of a length ball in line of the stumps, kept out to the on side by Fakhar.

FOUR! BAMM! Well, well, well Fakhar Zaman is in a hurry and he is showing it with his shot making. A fuller ball outside off from Chatara, Zaman drives it through covers and the fielder is square who has no chance of cutting it down.
Swept fine for a single.
Hangs back and keeps the shortish ball out.
Wrists the tossed up a ball and gets it to the on side for a single.
In comes Zaman dancing down the track to meet the flighted ball. He gives it a whack but it goes to the fielder at mid-wicket on a bounce. One run taken.
On leg, pushed to mid on run nothing.
Floated on middle and off, blocked off the back foot by Zaman.
Drinks! It's all too easy for Pakistan right now. This run chase seems like a mere formality. Can Zimbabwe change things to get back into the game? Unlikely but cricket is a strange game.
Width outside off, chopped though cover-point. One run to the scoreboard. 86 more runs needed for Pakistan.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for another single.
In line of the stumps, Imam flicks it to square leg. One run added to the total.
On a length outside off, Zaman opens the face of the bat and gets it to third man. One run taken.
A back of a length ball around off, cut to point by Zaman.
Tendai Chatara is back on.
Hangs back and keeps this one out. Zimbabwe need to change something or else they will lose it sooner then expected.
Around leg, played through the on side for a run.
Flatter on off, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! Intelligent stuff from Zaman. Masakadza fired this one around off, Zaman hangs back and guides the ball through third man using the pace. A boundary results which brings up consecutive 100-run stands between the duo. Both have looked solid throughout.
Fuller on middle, defended down the track by Fakhar.
Flighted around off, driven through covers by Zaman. The batsmen scamper for a brace.
Imam has punched the ball off the back foot.
A tad shorter from Liam. Imam rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Cut through point for a single.
On off, driven through long off. One run taken.
Flatter on leg, punched through long on for another run.

FOUR! Short and asking for it. Zaman is in too good a form to miss out on such opportunities. He gets to his 6th fifty in ODIs with this cut through backward point. Back to back half-centuries for the Peshawar-born batsman.
Driven towards the long on region. The batsmen have run through for a single. Pakistan are cruising here.
Faster one on off, Driven through the off side for another run.
Tucked around the corner by Imam. A flatter ball on the pads, Imam moves back and clips it fine. Two runs added to the total.
Flighted on off, driven to long off for a run.
Gets away with this one. A half tracker around off, Zaman punches it but finds the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Too full outside, Zaman shows his strength here. He hangs back and punches it through covers. A boundary results.
Wellington Masakadza is into the attack.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total. 8 off this over.
Similar ball from Roche, another push down the ground for a run.
In line of the stumps, pushed down the ground. One run taken.
FOUR! Easy-peasy for Zaman. Another shortish delivery outside off, Zaman hangs back and cuts it easily through cover-point for a boundary. It's all too easy for Pakistan right now.
A tad shorter, Zaman gets back and pushes it back to Roche.
Flighted on middle, pushed to long on for a run.
On a length around off, defended by Fakhar.

FOUR! Goodness me, that has gone to the boundary like a tracer bullet. Another half tracker from Tiripano, Zaman lines it up and pulls it through mid-wicket. A boundary results. A cracker this from Zaman.
Full on off, punched to covers for nothing.
Short in line of the stumps, Imam pulls it through mid-wicket. A run taken.
Around off, pushed to mid off by Zaman for a run.
On a length on leg, defended by Zaman.
Pushed to the cover region by Fakhar. They pick up a single.
FOUR! A freebie from Roche. A short ball around off, Zaman gets on the back foot and crunches it through covers. A boundary results.
In line of the stumps, Zaman gets forward and keeps it out.
A touch short, Zaman gets back and taps it to the off side.
Around off, blocked by Zaman.
Starts from around the wicket and bowls a nice faster delivery on middle, Fakhar pushes it back to him.
Liam Roche is on.
Taps this down in front of cover-point and scurries to the other end. Good running.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
A single in the mid-wicket area. Zaman works it just wide of the fielder there and calls his partner through.
Change of pace from Donald Tiripano. Bowls it full on the stumps, Zaman can only play it back to him.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire.

Wanted two but will have to settle for just the one. Imam moves inside the line and works it in front of square on the leg side. The fielder got to the ball quickly, hence why they decided against it.
Seaming away off the deck, Fakhar guides it down to third man for one run.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. That means a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Darts it on the hips, worked straight to the man at square leg.
Full ball attacking the base of off stump, Imam-ul-Haq with a gently push on the off side.
Fuller just around off, Imam takes a step across, strides forward and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Angling away from Imam, he goes back and slaps the cut, only to find the man at point.
Hangs inside the crease and punches it into the off side.

FOUR! Edged and it's away! Banged in short on middle, Imam takes on the pull but is in no control of this one. Gets a big top edge which flies across the fine leg fence after a few bounces. Runs coming thick and fast for Pakistan.
Length ball outside off, Zaman attempts to cut, does so, but off the under edge and it just whiskers past the off pole. Close call.
FOUR! The 50 comes up for Pakistan with that. Short ball, Zaman pulls this over square leg. There's only one fielder out there, at fine leg, and there's no way he's getting to that.
Smacked hard but right at the fielder. Full and fired outside off, Zaman hits it to the covers.
Doesn't cleanly middle this drive. Wants to go down the ground, does so but only finds mid off.
Skidding off the surface on off, on a good length. Fakhar defends it well with a straight blade.
Comfortably done. Width offered outside off, cut down to third man for a single.
Length delivery on leg, Zaman looks to go on the leg side but the ball lobs off his front pad and falls short of short third man.
Back of a length and it's tapped down on the off side with soft hands.

Good effort from Liam Roche. Superb stuff to prevent that boundary. Imam leans ahead nicely to this length ball and drives it beautifully through the covers. Roche from wide mid off hares after this and puts in a dive to parry it inches inside the rope. One run saved.
Outside off on a good length, no shot offered by the batsman.
FOUR! Using the pace and angle to his advantage. Shortish and moving away, Imam cuts this behind point. The placement is fine enough, as it beats third man who can't cut it off.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, left alone.
Short of a length outside off, punched off the middle straight to cover-point.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Back of a length around off, punched off the back foot.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Fakhar Zaman! He's offered some room outside off, on a back of a length, the southpaw cuts it hard through point. There is a fielder out in the deep this time, but even he can't stop it.
FOUR! Shot. Zaman nicely gets on top of this length ball and with pure timing punches this square through point. No stopping that, too good for that to happen.
Short of a good length close to off, Zaman swings his bat and gets an inside edge past the leg stump.
Donald Tiripano introduced into the attack.

Delightful! Zaman stays firm in his crease and just uses the extension of his arms to punch it through the covers. The fielder there chases it down and keeps it just inside the rope with a slide. Three runs taken.
Uses the angle away from him on this occasion. Glides it behind point and rotates strike.
Shaping away from around off, on a length, Imam covers the line well and leaves it for the keeper to collect.
Comes half-forward on this occasion and offers a defensive bat in response.
Shortens the length a touch, angles it across, Imam punches it away on the off side.
Edged but it's well short! Fuller and outside off, Zaman throws his bat at it and gets a thick edge which flies down to third man. One bounce to the fielder, one run collected.
Hangs back and defends it down on the track.
FOUR! Short ball which is put away! A gift for Imam as he rocks back, swivels and pulls it along the ground through mid-wicket. Boundary results.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Wide! Hurled too wide outside off, Imam doesn't play a shot. Across the tramline and that's a wide.
Fuller and wide outside off, Imam looks to drive but ends up getting beaten.
Fullish in length and attacking the stumps, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Moving about a bit in the air, length delivery outside off, punched behind point and the batsmen take one.
Fuller on the stumps, blocked back down the track. End of the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Rising off the deck from a good length, outside off, Imam moves across, covers the line and lets it be.
Driven through the gap in the covers this time. Single taken.
Slaps the drive to the covers, another good stop from the fielder there.
Going across on a length around off, Fakhar Zaman comes forward and drives this on the up towards covers. The fielder there dives to his left and stops it from going past him.
Shortens the length back by just a bit, defended in front of mid on to end the over.
Comes from around the wicket and lands it on a length outside off, Imam plants his front foot forward and shoulders arms.
Angling across on a length, crashed towards cover-point. Slight misfield from the fielder there, but no harm done.
Serves it on a length on middle and leg, clipped behind square on the leg side. Easy double taken.
Too straight on the pads, easy enough for Imam to work it through backward square leg for a brace.
Rising off the deck from a back of a length around off, Imam cuts his hard straight to point.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Drives this through the covers and gets to the other end for a single.

Chance of a run out! Missed. Zaman works it towards square leg and takes off. Start-stop stuff from the batsmen, there is a throw at the striker's end from Wellington but it just misses. A direct hit and Imam is gone.
Slightly fuller on middle and leg, Fakhar clears his front leg and pushes it away on the leg side.
Banged in shorter on off stump, Zaman rises on his toes and defends it off the inner half on his pads.
Good bowling. Excellent delivery first up. Good length ball very close to off, Zaman raises his arms and lets it through to the keeper.
Blessing Muzarabani will take the second new ball from the other end.
Shortish and on off, tapped down to point for a run. 10 from the first over, a good beginning by Pakistan.

FOUR! Fakhar is up and running also with a boundary. Poor delivery by Tendai, he serves it short and wide outside off and Zaman smashes it square of the wicket on the off side. Right through the gap and it speeds away to the fence.
Goes short now, on middle and leg, Imam pulls it down to long leg and rotates the strike.
Chatara once again tries to lure Imam into a cover drive but this time the last match centurion lets it through to the keeper.
Play and a miss! This time the bowler angles across a length delivery outside off, Imam once again tries to drive it through covers but fails to make any sort of connection.
FOUR! Shot! Great timing and placement. Chatara overpitches and bowls it around off, Imam leans into the drive and crunches it through covers for a boundary.

Back for the chase! The Zimbabwean players are taking the field. Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman are the Pakistan openers. Tendai Chatara to make first use of the first new ball. All set, let's play shouts umpire Ian Gould...
